# Shigley deep links

*Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 2024 edition*, ISBN 9781260407679, read through the BYU VitalSource Bookshelf. Each link opens the online reader at that exact spot. The links are edition-specific and entitlement-gated: a student who opted out of inclusive access sees an access error, so every citation carries the section number and the printed page as well, which work in any copy of the book.

**How to cite.** Write the section number and page beside the link, for example "Shigley [§3-12](url), p. 126". Cite the most specific spot that answers the question: a worked example, figure or table when there is one, otherwise the section. Link a chapter only when you mean the chapter as a whole. Never make a link up and never use a `pageid` address: if the spot you want has no link below, give its section number and page without one.

275 numbered sections, 169 of them linked; 21 worked examples, 11 figures and 4 tables. Section titles are the book's own (CAD there means computer-aided design).
